children: Tesla (TSLA) cut full-year capex guidance to $20B from $25B and trimmed 2026 capex to about $20B while maintaining sizable AI, robotics and autonomy investments.
Tesla (TSLA) Q revenue $28.05B, flat YoY. Operating income fell 56% to $718M. Automotive gross margin ex-credits 18.1%. Key figures for traders: revenue, profit drop, margin.
Tesla says over 75% of North American Q3 deliveries included paid FSD at delivery; company reports 1.7M+ global paid FSD customers and notes intro offers may affect figures.
Tesla (TSLA) under regulatory scrutiny: NHTSA probes its camera-only Full Self-Driving system, focusing on AI mapping, navigation implementation and testing. Investigations are ongoing.
Tesla (TSLA) plans to deliver Cybercabs to outside fleets by end of 2026 while the NHTSA reviews whether the steering-wheel-free vehicle meets federal safety rules.
Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk said FSD is a key demand driver, expects EU approval in months and that Tesla is seeking regulatory clearance for FSD in China.
Tesla (TSLA) posted operating cash flow $6.26B, capex $4.73B and free cash flow $1.53B for the period. Figures reported without timing or comparative detail.
Democratic gains in Congress could trigger probes into a Tesla–SpaceX merger, citing national-security and antitrust concerns over Elon Musk's control of critical infrastructure.
BNP Paribas raised Tesla (TSLA) to Neutral and lifted its price target to $420, citing possible SpaceX-Tesla ties and noting concerns about AI pace and high spending.
CLSA upgraded Tesla to Hold and lifted its target to $400 from $310, citing improved operating cash flow, Q3 positive free cash flow, growing AI focus, and possible closer SpaceX ties.
